supported_valid_go.definition: hard constraints satisfied, sufficient evidence, oracle-optimal

supported_suboptimal_go.definition: valid recommendation, sufficient evidence, not oracle-optimal

unnecessary_abstention.definition: premature abstention when task was completable

invalid.definition: runtime anomaly / illegal schema / unacceptable state

principles: sub-optimal with evidence is a VALID recommendation (positive regret)
unsupported GO loss >= abstention cost (no reward for unsafe guessing)
correct abstention not penalized more than unsafe recommendation
multi-metric reporting (valid/unvalid/unsupported/constraint/regret/cost); task loss v2.1 is the pre-registered composite
implementation: task_loss_v21 in src/marketpilot/evaluation/outcomes.py; reason_code on TaskOutcome
non_tuning: weights frozen pre-registration; no selection by prior TEST winner
